# Queued section loader

Native load callback that copies a section through the flash wrapper.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x600421e1` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

Reads through the flash wrapper 0x600720e1 to an uncached destination alias. Waiter 0x60042123 later runs the initialiser dispatcher and sets the loaded-mask bit.
